seo.description: Partner with AfriNuts Export: Outgrower cooperatives, white-label processing, Farm OS licensing, and joint venture processing. Let's build the future of West African agribusiness together.
seo.introBody: Four partnership models designed for different organizations. From outgrower cooperatives to Farm OS licensing — we have a path for you. Every partnership is backed by our operational farm, proprietary technology, and commitment to transparency.

hero.lead: You bring distribution, capital, or operational scale. We bring Farm OS, traceability, and a 35-hectare proof of concept. Partnerships are not an afterthought — they are how we scale.

whyPartner.title: Why Partner with AfriNuts
whyPartner.body: We're not a trading desk. We're a tech-enabled agribusiness platform with operational assets, proprietary software, and a clear certification roadmap.

items.title: Farm OS Technology
items.desc: Our custom-built operating system tracks every tree, every block, and every export. Partners get real-time visibility into production, quality, and traceability — not quarterly PDFs.

items.title: Operational Farm
items.desc: We are not a trading desk. We own and operate a 35-hectare farm with 3,500 trees. We have skin in the game — and the data to prove it.

items.title: Certified Supply Chain
items.desc: Organic, Halal, ISO 22000, and Fair Trade certifications (in progress) open doors to premium markets that commodity suppliers cannot access.

items.title: Community Roots
items.desc: 200+ farmers in our cooperative. 10% of profits reinvested locally. Partnership with us is partnership with Odienné.

models.title: Partnership Models
models.body: Four clear paths to partner with us. Each model is designed for a specific type of organization with specific value exchange.

items.title: Outgrower Cooperative
items.idealFor: NGOs, agricultural development programs, impact investors

weOffer: Farm OS traceability for your brand

currentPartners.title: Our First Partners: 200+ Farmers
currentPartners.body: Our cooperative in Odienné is proof that the partnership model works.
currentPartners.description: We provide training, fair pricing, and guaranteed off-take. They provide the harvest. Together, we're building a supply chain that benefits everyone — not just the middleman.

items.a: On a case-by-case basis depending on territory, volume commitment, and partnership model. Let's discuss what works for both parties.
Yes. We welcome serious partners to visit Odienné and see Farm OS in action. There is no substitute for seeing the operation firsthand.

items.q: What is the minimum volume for white-label?
items.a: We accommodate pilot runs to test the relationship. Contact us to discuss your specific needs and timeline.

items.q: Is Farm OS available for other crops?
items.a: Farm OS is currently built for cashew, but the platform is crop-agnostic. We are open to adaptation partnerships for cocoa, shea, coffee, and other West African crops.
See our certification roadmap. Organic (2027), Halal (2029), ISO 22000 (2029), Fair Trade (2030). Our farm has been chemical-free since inception.

items.q: How does Farm OS benefit me as a partner?
items.a: Farm OS gives partners real-time visibility into the supply chain. If you're white-labeling, you see exactly which batch your product came from. If you're licensing, you get a field-tested platform without building from scratch. Every partner gets access to the data that matters to their model.

items.q: What does the partnership process look like after I reach out?
items.a: 1) We schedule a call to understand your needs. 2) You sign an NDA. 3) We share relevant operational data and Farm OS demo access. 4) We design a pilot project together — small scope, clear metrics. 5) If the pilot succeeds, we scale the partnership.

cta.title: Ready to Build?
cta.body: Tell us which partnership model fits your organization. We'll send you a partnership brochure and schedule a call to explore the details.
